dct_title_s: Northern Mariana Islands Typhoon Sinlaku: Damage Proxy Map, Apr 2026
dct_description_sm: # EOS-RS Damage Proxy Map: Northern Mariana Islands, U.S., Typhoon Sinlaku, 25 Apr 2026, v0.9 The Earth Observatory of Singapore - Remote Sensing Lab (EOS-RS) created this preliminary Damage Proxy Map (DPM) depicting areas that are likely damaged in the Northern Mariana Islands, U.S., following Typhoon Sinlaku in April 2026. Typhoon Sinlaku made landfall over the northern Tinian Islands at 14:30 UTC on 14 Apr 2026. This map was derived from synthetic aperture radar (SAR) images acquired by the Copernicus Sentinel-1 satellite operated by the European Space Agency (ESA) before (20 Nov 2025 to 1 Apr 2026) and after (25 Apr 2026) the event. The map covers an area indicated by the white polygon. Damage is shown by colored pixels of 30m in size, where yellow to red indicates increasingly significant ground surface change before and after the event. Preliminary validation was conducted using news reports and ground-level imagery and videos in selected areas. This map should be used as a guidance to identify damaged areas, and may be less reliable over vegetated or mountainous areas. Scattered pixels over vegetated or mountainous areas may be false positives, and a lack of colored pixels over such areas may not mean no damage. The product contains modified Copernicus Sentinel data (2025 - 2026), processed by ESA and analyzed by the Earth Observatory of Singapore - Remote Sensing Lab (EOS-RS). **More map details and files:** **Legal Disclaimer:** **Credits:** Earth Observatory of Singapore - Remote Sensing Lab (EOS-RS), Contains modified Copernicus Sentinel data (2025 - 2026)
